svg.text: PLACEHOLDER · characters: aria, bram, sylfie · seed: None

text.tspan: Aria stands on Practice Meadow at golden hour, oversized blush-
pink robe glowing, messy chestnut bob with lavender streak
catching light, determined grin, mint satchel at hip, charred
and flowered practice dummies behind her, Bram counting on
fingers nearby, Sylfie floating effortlessly with sparkles, ward
stones pulsing at village edge in background. Characters: ARIA:
human girl 7-8, small stocky build, warm beige skin with nose
freckles, messy chin-length chestnut bob (#5d4037) with single
lavender streak (#c7b8ea), large bright amber-gold eyes
sleeves, mint-green satchel (#a8e6cf), scuffed brown boots
ink-smudged fingers, singed robe hem, tiny star scar on chin,
determined concentrated expression with tongue peeking out |
